results.name: Initial reconciliation creates a shared checkpoint, preserves identities and requires two-way acknowledgement
Market/stock purchase +30 while shop sells 15 converges from 50 to 65 without financial duplication
Unequal six-month and two-month histories preserve 180 saved days without replaying their stock movements
Simultaneous independent sales 10 and 8 retain both records and converge to 32 units
Restock 24, sale 12 and damage 3 from 40 units converge to 49 with permanent adjustment events
Duplicate file import, renamed reimport, restart and repeated exchange never replay a 24-unit purchase
Conflicting current selling prices require approval and never rewrite prior sale prices
Market advance, cash sales, funded purchase and return reconcile to 85000 without double deduction
Concurrent absolute count and sale are flagged; a verified correction keeps both transactions and future sales
Thirty days of offline transactions preserve 120 sales and converge using sequences despite clock skew
A storage failure during merge leaves all business domains and applied IDs unchanged; retry succeeds once
Wrong-business, corrupted encryption, unsupported versions and Full Backup through sync are rejected unchanged
Independently created similar products with different packaging require explicit variant matching
Legacy transactions without original IDs remain uncertain until explicitly reconciled
Sales recorded after recovery snapshots but before checkpoint acceptance survive enrollment and follow-up sync
Concurrent sales exceeding shared stock retain both sales and expose a shortage instead of deleting activity
Supplier credit and independent partial payments reconcile purchase, cash and liability exactly once
Sale + Cash Out transfers 1500 electronic, records 1100 retail sales and pays 400 cash once
Post-sync Full Backup restores records, checkpoint and applied-event protection while keeping a fresh installation identity
Two truly independent transactions with identical product, quantity, amount and timestamp are both retained
Native sale deletion becomes a permanent amendment/tombstone, restores stock once and cannot resurrect through repeated exchange
A to B to enrolled C to A exchange converges without duplicate events or copying installation identity
Interrupted initial reconciliation reloads as pending and resumes the approved proposal without duplicate activities
Same event identifier with different content and missing sequence dependencies are integrity conflicts
Purchased-but-not-received stock stays unavailable, and its later receipt applies once on both devices
Financial private movements are encrypted in transit/local event storage, merged once and guarded by existing PIN
